label: Schedule B Part III taxpayer-assertion vocabulary for tax year 2025

fact_types.title: Schedule B Part III, question 7a: at any time during 2025 did you have a financial interest in or signature authority over a financial account located in a foreign country? (ADR-0036 decision 4: categorical taxpayer-assertion pattern, value domain {yes, no}, never boolean - a no is a present, non-maskable answer.)

Schedule B Part III, question 8: did you receive a distribution from, or were you the grantor of, or transferor to, a foreign trust? (ADR-0036 decision 4: categorical taxpayer-assertion pattern, value domain {yes, no}, never boolean.)

Schedule B Part III, question 7b: the name of the foreign country where the financial account is located. Required only when question 7a is answered yes (ADR-0036 decision 4 branch requirement); a categorical closed-country-list domain, never a free-text field.
